channel_contract.BaseColor: 8-bit RGB sRGB reflectance, no baked lighting or AO
channel_contract.ORM: 8-bit RGB linear: occlusion 1, varying roughness, metallic; no geometry AO invented
channel_contract.Normal: 8-bit RGB DirectX tangent perturbations for the new world projection graph; tiny physical relief, no displacement
channel_contract.projection: Centimetres per tile, same scale on XYZ faces; world position, independent of object UV/scale
